name: Full Site Function and Tool Audit
purpose: Validate every public HTML surface, local route, linked asset, JavaScript syntax contract, JSON feed, download route, form surface and critical interactive tool before Cloudflare deployment, then verify the critical routes again against the live Worker deployment.
criticalTools: Research Tools and private runner status
Signal Board forums and D1 health
Download Center and every visible action target
Power Dossiers and their loading fallback
hardFailureRules: Missing critical page, script or data feed
Broken local target on a critical page
Visible button or link with no destination
Dossier page that can remain permanently stuck in a loading state
Fragile Geographic Power Atlas runtime restored
Malformed entity output such as [object Object]
Live route missing its expected marker
Live Worker response missing its origin header
automaticRepairs: Use stable MapLibre dynamic import with an accessible-list-first fallback
Fall back from the preferred atlas JSON alias to the canonical GeoJSON
Remove malformed entity names, invalid connections and generated object-object pages
Attach a resilient power-dossier runtime with a clear source-route fallback
Remove visible compatibility and repair markers after all generators finish
Preserve the free-evidence and monthly-donation membership promise
warningRules: Form without an obvious submit control or JavaScript hook
Noncritical script fetch target requiring manual review
Third-party browser library unavailable while a local accessible fallback remains

liveVerification.scope: Homepage, major navigation, search, Atlas, maps, timeline, data lab, research tools, timers, speculation, membership, member surfaces, forums, downloads, machine outputs, dossier data and Worker health.

boundary: Static and postbuild audits validate the shipped site bundle. Live verification validates public read routes and Worker responses. Authenticated transactions, PayPal sandbox approval, email delivery, D1 writes and private runner execution require valid test accounts and configured external services.
